+# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import os
+
+import pytest
+
+def test_utf8_encoding_declaration():
+    # This test verifies that a script containing Chinese characters runs without SyntaxError
+    script_content = '''
+# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
+def main():
+    prompt = '这是一个测试'  # Chinese characters
+    print(prompt)
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()
+'''
+    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile('w', suffix='.py', delete=False, encoding='utf-8') as f:
+        f.write(script_content)
+        temp_path = f.name
+    try:
+        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, temp_path], capture_output=True, text=True)
+        assert result.returncode == 0
+        assert '这是一个测试' in result.stdout
+    finally:
+        os.remove(temp_path)

[Bug]:Workstation does not support Chinese characters?
Workstation bug:
When I fill in Chinese characters in the content of the message or the system prompt of the agent in the workflow, an error message appears:

SyntaxError: Non-UTF-8 code starting with '\xc4' in file C:\Users\Lenovo\AppData\Local\Temp\tmpw0lirvil.py on line 31, but no encoding declared; see https://peps.python.org/pep-0263/ for details

In fact, in the Grop Chat example, the system prompt of angents already contains a few Chinese characters - single quotation marks. I need to change them before it can start.
